notes.title: Trading Cards are available now!
notes.content: Trading Cards, Badges, Emoticons and Profile Backgrounds are now available to collect by playing 1000 days to escape.

notes.title: Patch note 2: Saves, friends leaderboards, hotkeys, etc
notes.content:
[*] Saves. You can continue the game that you have left. But your HIGH SCORE WON'T BE RECORDED in this case. This is to avoid abusing saves to planets exploring.
[*] "Friends only" checkbox in the leaderboards to let you check out high scores of your friends.
[*] Added some hotkeys. 1-5 / S, M, B, H, R- switching between screens; P - pause; Q / BACKSPACE - back; SPACE - launch.
[*] Reworked map generation to avoid unwinnable situations.
[*] Gas giants now displayed with 0 capacity.
[*] Increased speed of loading people into the rocket.
[*] Fixed some bugs when game was paused.
[*] FIxed a bug with suddenly hidden UI.
[*] Fixed a bug with the game over condition.
[*] Fixed a bug with wrong music track on quit to menu.
[*] Fixed a bug with unpaused game while artifacts message is on the screen.

notes.title: Patch note 1: Bug fixing
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Spanish localization.
[*] Corrected some korean words.
[*] Added saving settings.
[*] Fixed stuck on transition between screens.
[*] Fixed a bug with shifted house.
[*] Fixed displaying of long nicknames in the leaderboard.
[*] Fixed a bug when your crew died after won war.
[*] Fixed a bug when your rocket suddenly ran out of fuel.
[*] Fixed a double award for planet colonization.
[*] Fixed a crash on quit to main menu.
[*] Fixed a bug when you moved all the people, but the game still continue.
[*] Fixed "Healthy Perfectionism" achievement.
[*] Fixed a bug when using multiple types of fuel.
[*] Improved tab changes on the factory screen.
[/list]

If you find a bug, please report in discussions.
